rows.label: qst104213_msg0001
rows.name:
Legendary hero... sparkly princess...
tiny fairy...

rows.label: qst104213_msg0002
rows.name:
Mo-mo! I was lost in the world
of a book, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0003
rows.name:
Lapupu is still just a child and not
a sparkly princess, but...

rows.label: qst104213_msg0004
rows.name:
Inside a book, Lapupu can be a hero,
a princess, or even a fairy, mo!

rows.label: qst104213_msg0005
rows.name:
I want to teach that becoming someone
wonderful helps you understand others
and become kinder, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0006
rows.name:
Lapupu, a teacher in Iyasaki Village?
What should I do, mo...?

rows.label: qst104213_msg0007
rows.name:
Mama always says Nopon should live
freely, so I think she'll approve,
but...

rows.label: qst104213_msg0008
rows.name:
Mama always tells me I'm too young
to need them, but...

rows.label: qst104213_msg0009
rows.name:
I want to buy cosmetics and
accessories so I can become
a princess, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0010
rows.name:
Lapupu wants to try being a princess
outside of a book, too, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0011
rows.name: I want 7,500G to go shopping, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0012
rows.name: Pay 7,500G?

rows.label: qst104213_msg0013
rows.name: Pay

rows.label: qst104213_msg0014
rows.name: Don't pay

rows.label: qst104213_msg0081
rows.name:
Too bad, mo... When I get bigger,
I'll buy them myself, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0082
rows.name:
By then, will I already be a
sparkly princess, mo...?

rows.label: qst104213_msg0101
rows.name:
With 7,500G, I can go shopping
and become a princess, mo...

rows.label: qst104213_msg0151
rows.name:
Yay, yay! Time to shop, mo~!
Time to become a princess, mo~!

rows.label: qst104213_msg0152
rows.name:
Once I'm done being a princess,
I'll go to Iyasaki Village, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0153
rows.name:
This is Lapupu's first time on an
adventure outside of a book, mo!

rows.label: qst104213_msg0154
rows.name: See you later, mo~!

rows.label: qst104213_msg0181
rows.name:
Have you picked a teacher, mo?
I tried being a teacher in a book, mo.
It was fun, mo.

rows.label: qst104213_msg0201
rows.name:
Someday, Lapupu wants to
become a princess outside
of a book, too, mo~.
